text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE:- 1) TO BE INDUCTION HARDENED UPTO 45 ~ 55 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.6~ 2 mm AFTER FINISH GRINDING."},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"NOTE:- 1)TO BE TOUGHENED TO 28-30 HRc."}],"comment":"Note N1 requires induction hardening to 45–55 HRC while note N4 requires toughening to 28–30 HRc; these are contradictory hardness specifications for the same part, which will confuse heat treatment and cause scrap or field failure. The designer must reconcile the two notes into a single, unambiguous heat-treatment requirement (e.g., through-hardened core with induction-hardened zones).","recommended_correction":"Delete or revise one of the conflicting heat-treatment notes so that only one consistent hardness specification remains on the drawing."}]}
